protocol.statistic: median over trials; uncertainty is the median absolute deviation (unscaled); min and max kept

rerun.reason: the first run used a harness build that aborted when the writer refused an over-cap observation set; the rerun records the refusal and keeps the other phases

normalized: reported.equalToOracleCounts was removed from 24 rust-compat measures: the observations those runs read were exported without the oracle evaluation, so the field was always false; the fidelity check is each cell.verification (untimed, oracle evaluated once per cell)
